name: medagents-benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate agent and model performance on medical knowledge and clinical tasks, including question answering and clinical decision-making vignettes. It measures correctness, reasoning quality, and safety of generated medical outputs across a range of scenarios representative of clinical workflows. The suite is aimed at assessing models' ability to produce clinically accurate and safe recommendations rather than purely general-language performance.
reputation: A recently published/hosted dataset on Hugging Face with growing interest from the medical-NLP and agent-evaluation communities but not yet widely standardized.
